启动少女前线2说明:
1.Select the correct controller and resource in Connection Settings. Emulator and PC resources must be selected manually.

2.Before using the PC client, set the game to 1280x720 resolution and launch the script as administrator (right-click MaaGF2Exilium.exe → Properties → Compatibility → check "Run this program as an administrator"). The controller and resource must also be set to the PC options.

3.Server selection is available under Settings → Task Settings → Global Settings. Server selection only works on the emulator; for PC, use the pre-execution script or launch the game manually.

易物所商店兑换说明:
This task only buys items placed in the in-game Wishlist.

Before running, open Shop → Wishlist (bottom left of the Shop screen) and star the items you want. The task then visits the 6 shops that support wishlisting (Furniture, Platoon, Dispatch, Battlelog, Neural, Growth) and buys out every wishlisted item in stock; items that are not in the Wishlist are left untouched.
